commit.message:
Clarify base strategy and allow vendor specific formats

redirect RV32YE to CHERIoT, as discussed with Haydn

Move the memory space section out of the appendix

Move it into the base chapter instead.

Move integrity of capabilities out of the encoding appendix

This makes more sense in the base chapter.

Split the capability encoding appendix into RV64 and RV32 chapters

Also enhance the "CHERI encoding formats" section.
fix some typos
one typo and a few xref fixes
add encoding summary tables
correct rvy32 to rvy64
attempt to add paraemters to encoding so it covers rv32y and rv64y, weak connection so pushing before full review
L8 bit consistent naming
table fix

Consistently use L8 with a subscript

Had to use a unicode escape for the bytefield-svg version since using
`~8~` does not work due to some asciidoc restrictions.

Don't say Zyseal is incompatible

It will be compatible, we just haven't allocated the bit patterns yet.
Simplify mode description for the RVY32 encoding

Update 32/64 bit compatibility table to reference RV{64,32}I

For example Zcf is not compatible with RVY64

Clarify M bit encoding
